interpretation.startingStats: Raw hero intrinsic starting-stat parameters from local heroes.vdata.
interpretation.standardLevelUpUpgrades: Raw standard level/boon progression parameters. Their exact semantic application order remains to be validated before effective-stat calculation.
interpretation.scalingStats: Hero-specific cross-stat scaling relationships. These are especially important because changing one state variable such as Spirit may alter another hero statistic.
interpretation.purchaseBonuses: Category-investment progression structures associated with item-slot categories. These are progression effects separate from the individual properties of the purchased item.
interpretation.levelInfo: Hero progression/required-gold substrate. No assumption is made here that replay boon state has already been reconstructed.
interpretation.keyGuardrail: Resource-defined base and progression values are not the same as effective runtime PlayerState(t). Items, permanent buffs, temporary buffs, ability state, debuffs, and other modifiers remain separate layers.
